messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 15 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 15 November until 06:00 Sunday 16 November for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close all documents before 22:00. Email will be unaffected. Contact the helpdesk on x4000 with any queries.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
